text: At its meeting on April 19, 2018, the City-School Boards Advisory Committee considered a report (March 26, 2018) from the Executive Director, Social Development, Finance and Administration on Final Progress Report: City-School Boards Advisory Committee Staff Workplan.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council forward the report (March 26, 2018) from the Executive Director, Social Development, Finance and Administration to the four School Boards operating in Toronto and to the Minister of Education.
